## Why this study was run

**Research question:** [How far can query-only routing go?](../questions/query-only-routing.qmd)

Compare dense query encoders and neighborhood sizes for transferring candidate relevance.

**Rationale:** Reconstructed from the dense-query result receipt and ledger.

## Protocol and comparison

**Hypothesis:** Semantic query neighbors improve on simple query controls.

Evaluate four embedding families across fixed neighborhood sizes on the development set.

Any run comparison below is partitioned by ledger evaluation scope.

## Current result

**Outcome:** `positive`

Dense retrieval established the stable query-only control; parameter variants remain diagnostic.

## Decision and rationale

**Decision:** `retain_control`

Retain dense_nested as the frozen query-only control.

Rationale provenance: `reconstructed`.

## Evidence limits

Development-only and adaptively explored; most variants have aggregate-only evidence.

Development results do not establish hidden-test effectiveness.
